title: Stall
description: One stall inside one venue. Lives in data/venues/<venue-slug>.json, one file per venue holding an array of these. The unit number is the address; the name is the tenant -- a stall renaming must not break its identity (venue-slug + unit).

unit.description: Normalised to e.g. 01-23, # stripped. This plus the venue slug is the stall's permanent identity.

name.description: Required when status is "open". Omitted (never a blank string) when unknown.

halal.description: Only ever set true with a cited MUIS certificate number recorded alongside it (outside this schema, in the collection notes) -- never inferred.

hours.description: Keyed by lowercase 3-letter day, e.g. { "tue": "11:00-19:30" }. Omit days that are unknown -- do not guess.

direction_hint.description: One line of human-written orientation, e.g. "Level 1, aisle nearest Maxwell Road, opposite the drinks stall." This replaces a drawn floor plan.

photos.description: Relative paths. Every entry must have a lawful-source sidecar per the rights policy -- shot by the team, submitted through the tip flow with a licence grant, or sent by the owner with written confirmation. Never AI-generated, never lifted from a blog or Instagram.

editorial.description: "pick" is a label (Tony's Picks), not a score. There is no star rating field in this schema -- none is ever invented.

collected_by.description: Initials of whoever verified this record in person. Required -- a record with no accountable collector does not publish.

verified.description: Date this stall was last checked in person. A record past its re-check deadline (90/180/365 days by tier) displays as stale, never silently as current.

moved_to.description: Set only on a tombstoned stall record. Stalls are never deleted -- a closed stall becomes "Closed as of <date>", still indexed.
